candidateHeadEquivalence: HEAD delta after takeover is independent N8.8.A evidence-only receipt; no N8.11 product/security runtime files changed.

freshInspection.objective: Directed current-standard OWASP/security preflight for authentication, authorization/tenant isolation, security headers/proxy trust, rate limits, secrets/configuration, dependencies, uploads and public APIs.
observedControls: JWT bearer validates issuer, audience, lifetime and signing key with zero clock skew; weak/CHANGE_ME JWT secret fails startup.
Anonymous login is bounded by named fixed-window rate limiting and login success/failure is audited.
CORS requires an explicit non-empty origin allowlist; Swagger is disabled outside Development unless explicitly enabled.
HSTS is enabled outside Development; HTTPS redirection and nosniff, DENY frame, no-referrer and restrictive Permissions-Policy headers are applied.
Tenant-aware permission filter requires positive X-Empresa-Id and permission resolution verifies the authenticated user's actual scope/membership before relational role permission checks.
Mass upload endpoints are authenticated, permission-gated and bounded to 6 MiB with XLSX structural validation before service processing.
Repository appsettings contains placeholders rather than deployed DB/JWT/Cloudinary/SMTP secret values; migrations-on-startup is disabled by default.
directedRisksForSubsequentN8_11Stages: Verify ForwardedHeaders trust configuration under the real reverse proxy because KnownNetworks/KnownProxies are cleared while login throttling partitions by RemoteIpAddress.
Enumerate AllowAnonymous/public token routes and verify intended scope, bounded lifetime/access and abuse controls.
Exercise horizontal/vertical tenant and RBAC negative tests on sensitive admin, finance and inventario surfaces.
Exercise malformed/boundary upload cases including type/content mismatch, resource exhaustion and cross-tenant write prevention.
Run current .NET/frontend dependency vulnerability scans and repair any causal high/critical exposure before final certification.
Verify deployed headers/CORS/rate limiting and confirm no secret material leaks to logs/errors/evidence.
freshInspection.rollback: PRE is evidence-only. Any later hardening must be minimal, independently reversible and regression-tested before certification.
freshInspection.testStrategy: Use targeted negative authz/tenant tests, proxy/rate-limit/header probes, public-route contract tests, upload malformed/boundary tests, dependency vulnerability scans and causal CI in N8.11.D-F-G. Do not lower controls to obtain PASS.
